title: knoxia roxburghii var. brunonis
intro: Knoxia roxburghii var. brunonis, commonly known as Roxburgh's knoxia or knoxia, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The health benefits of Roxburgh's knoxia are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects.
